variants.hook: I build backend systems that stay up when everything else is falling over.
variants.body: I'm a Senior Backend Engineer at Acme Corp, where I lead work on distributed systems that serve millions of requests a day. Over the past several years I've redesigned caching layers to cut latency by 40%, led the migration of a monolith to microservices for a 12-engineer team, and mentored three engineers to promotion. I care about systems that are simple to reason about even as they scale.
variants.cta: If you're tackling a hard distributed-systems problem, I'd love to hear about it -- feel free to reach out.

variants.hook: Distributed systems, at scale, without the 3am pages.
variants.body: At Acme Corp I've spent my time as Senior Backend Engineer turning fragile infrastructure into something a team can trust: a redesigned caching layer (40% latency reduction), a monolith-to-microservices migration for 12 engineers, and hands-on mentoring for three engineers who've since been promoted. I'm drawn to problems where reliability and simplicity have to coexist.
